'''Tumblebaskers''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] that lived in the [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[seatree]] [[Forest/Legends|forests]] of the [[Mkbuto Seatree Preserve]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]
[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Along with [[needlefish]], [[blossoming gulper]]s, and seatrees, tumblebaskers were a part of the region's delicate ecosystem.<ref name="GatORW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tumblebaskers were mentioned in the [[2004]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''.<ref name="GatORW" />
